announcements.author: Gwen Balajediong
announcements.title: Built-in Announcer & v1.2.0 Fixes
announcements.body:
Welcome to the DrionTune #announcements log. You can check here anytime for release notes, hotfixes, and important notices.

v1.2.0 brings cleaner DPI controls, direct GCash/GoTyme InstaPay QR in the Pro tab, and skeleton loading states across Boost & Debloater.

announcements.author: Gwen Balajediong
announcements.title: v1.1.4 Downloads Paused
announcements.body: Public v1.1.4 APK downloads were paused while finishing the v1.2.0 Game Mode and Pro tab fixes. Existing users can stay tuned here for the v1.2.0 rollout.
